curves.page_reference: p. 2, Fig. 3 Typical Instantaneous Forward Characteristics
curves.test_conditions: TJ = 25 degC; pulse width = 300 us; 1% duty cycle

extraction_notes: Forward-current and capacitance curve points are visually digitized from the drawn traces on p. 2; their values are approximate readings, not separately tabulated values.

For 6A10, the p. 1 maximum ratings table specifies VRRM = 1000 V, VDC = 1000 V, I(AV) = 6.0 A at TA = 60 degC and 0.375 in lead length, and IFSM = 200 A for an 8.3 ms single half sine-wave superimposed on rated load.
The p. 1 table separately publishes 100 uA maximum reverse current at rated DC blocking voltage and TA = 100 degC; it is not used as the reported 25 degC reverse-current value.
extraction.omission_reason: Reverse-recovery time is not published. No breakdown voltage or breakdown-current test point is published; the 1000 V entries are maximum blocking-voltage ratings, not measured breakdown-characteristic values.
